info.name: Farmess API
info.description: Every Farmess API endpoint with sample requests and status tests. Signed out (default), protected endpoints must return 401 and public ones 200 (or 503 when a provider key is not configured). To test signed in, set the collection variable 'cookie' to the Cookie header from a signed-in browser session.
